Case reference: 2014003474.CaseDesc: Christine Pelletier was last seen on July 21, 1988, in the Vieux-Rosemont District of Montreal, Quebec. Christine lived with friends, was engaged in a high-risk lifestyle, and may have been suffering from mental health issues.

Tattoo: Left Shoulder, Winged horse on the back of the shoulder. Possibly a Pegasus

Case reference: 2014005841.CaseDesc: Alfred Sassin has not been seen since he left his home in downtown Vancouver on July 9, 2012. Mr. Sassin's absence was reported to police by the resident caretakers on July 16, as they had not seen him for over a week, which was unusual for him.

Case reference: 2009004699.CaseDesc: On September 14, 1994, Kenneth Blais, 27 years of age, had an argument with his mother. He left his residence on Levesque Street, Sturgeon Falls, Ontario, saying he was going to meet up with his father. The family assumed that Kenneth went to the Ottawa region. Kenneth never met up with his father and is still missing.

Tattoo: Left Upper Arm, Cross done by hand

Case reference: 2021036430.CaseDesc: On May 22, 2012, John Fruehauf was last seen near the American Falls located at Prospect Point in Niagara Falls, New York. At the time of his disappearance, John was despondent.

Shirt: Other, Light coloured worn underneath the long sleeve.
Other, Dark coloured with long sleeves

Case reference: 2014005330.CaseDesc: On September 13, 2009, at approximately 6:30 a.m., Rose Mackinnon was seen for the last time when she left the Earnestine Women’s shelter with her two children. Rose advised that she would be returning but has not been seen since.

Case reference: 2024022215.CaseDesc: Jacob Penner was last seen on May 6, 2024 in the vicinity of High Level, Alberta. The Royal Canadian Mounted Police (RCMP) is requesting the public's cooperation in providing information regarding the location of Jacob.

Case reference: 2014003167.CaseDesc: Rufus Standingribbon was last seen in the month of October 1999 near Spirit River, Alberta. Rufus Standingribbon did not notify anyone that he was going to be leaving the area as he normally did.

Case reference: 2014004899.CaseDesc: Claude Barbier was last seen on November 16, 1996, with his girlfriend at the Cooke residence in Trois-Rivières, Quebec. Case reference: 2006019599.CaseDesc: Frank Szpak left his residence on September 23, 1996. He indicated he was going to pick blueberries and never returned. Frank suffered from Alzheimer's Disease.

Hat: Blue, Baseball cap with "Motorola" on the front

Case reference: 2018067156.CaseDesc: On November 27, 2018, Courtney James was seen for the last time on security camera footage in Niagara Falls, Ontario.

Case reference: 2024015900.CaseDesc: Mary Clarke left her residence in Guelph, Ontario, on April 8, 1990.  Her vehicle was later found abandoned in a parking lot in Niagara Falls, Ontario.

Coat: Wool, Blue, Tan, Knee length tweed trench coat.

Case reference: 2014004062.CaseDesc: Steve Langlois left the dock at Port Daniel, Gascons, Quebec on April 27, 1996 on a lobster fishing boat. The boat was then hit by a wave and capsized and Steve has not been found.

Case reference: 2014002183.CaseDesc: On July 1st, 1979, John Wong was seen for the last time leaving the area of the Grace Gospel Church in Niagara Falls, Ontario. His vehicle was located on Portage Road in close proximity to the Niagara River. John has not been seen or heard from since.

Case reference: 2025067893.CaseDesc: The skeletonised remains of this young adult male were discovered in a ravine in Burnaby, British Columbia, on October 15, 2025. It is likely that he was missing for up to 18 months prior to being found, and he had sustained an injury to his right foot, which had become infected.

Case reference: 2022041482.CaseDesc: Henry McAdam, a member of the Big River First Nation in Saskatchewan, was last seen on July 14, 2022, in the vicinity of Prince Albert. On July 24, 2022, a family member reported him missing. Henry adopted a transient and high-risk lifestyle and is known for using housing resources for the homeless. There is no indication of foul play at this time.

Case reference: 2018005158.CaseDesc: Darryl Langan was last seen on Highway 10 on January 19th, 2018, walking from Melville to Yorkton, Saskatchewan, in the vicinity of the community of Otthon (between Melville and Yorkton, Saskatchewan).

Case reference: 2014003060.CaseDesc: Pierre Lagacé was last seen on January 5, 2003, where he was living in the LeMoyne sector of Longueuil, Québec. Pierre was reported missing by a family member and at the time of his disappearance, he had little money and no car in his name.

Case reference: 2005002599.CaseDesc: On October 21, 1989, an unidentified man was discovered in the area of County Road 14 in Napanee, Ontario.  Biogeographic ancestry testing predicts that this man was of south Asian ancestry.

Shirt: White, Brand: Pierre Cardin; grey, blue, and red thin stripes

Case reference: 2024006090.CaseDesc: Beverly Musick was seen for the last time in the area of the Seneca Casino in Niagara Falls, New York, USA on June 8, 2004.  The next morning, her personal belongings were located on Luna Island, NY. At the time of her disappearance, Beverly was feeling despondent.

Case reference: 2006008799.CaseDesc: Doris Fennell was last observed at the home of an acquaintace in Kitley-Elizabeth Township, near Addison, Ontario. Foul Play is strongly suspected in her disappearance.

Case reference: 2014004724.CaseDesc: On November 20, 2004, Corey Braun travelled from Fort St. John, British Columbia to attend his employer's Christmas party at the Peace Valley Inn in Peace River, Alberta. At 3:00 a.m. on November 21, 2004, Corey was last seen by co-workers walking to his room at the Peace Valley Inn. Since then, Corey has neither been seen nor heard from.

Coat: Denim, Blue, light blue jean jacket

Case reference: 2014004464.CaseDesc: Singh Sukmwinder Lebahna was last seen in Montreal, Quebec on February 26, 2004. Singh Sukmwinder left the apartment he was sharing with a friend, taking all his personal belongings, stating he wanted to live in Vancouver, British Columbia. Singh Sukmwinder is originally from India.

Case reference: 2020006644.CaseDesc: On July 6, 1980, Andrew Jenkins was seen for the last time in Toronto, Ontario. During the time of his disappearance, Andrew may have been despondent.

Scar: Left Side Of Neck, Two inches

Case reference: 2014005313.CaseDesc: On September 24, 2007, Azelea Brown last spoke to her mother who was overseas.

Case reference: 2014029389.CaseDesc: Jed Ouillette was last seen on the afternoon of September 8 2014 in the Kitchener area of Ontario. His identity documents were left at his home. Jed had lost his drivers licence due to medical conditions, including seizures, and was also experiencing financial difficulties.

Shirt: Design on the front with short sleeves and a collar.
Shorts: White, Other, Above the knees and has belt loops.

Case reference: 2014005000.CaseDesc: On August 10, 2004, Louis Lathlin was reported missing to police by his wife. She told police the last time she saw him was on June 14, when he left The Pas for Winnipeg, Manitoba for a doctor's appointment on the 15th. He took only personal hygiene items and no clothing. He later called his wife and told her that he would be staying in Winnipeg as he had another appointment on Thursday. He called his wife on Saturday morning requesting money. His wife sent the money as requested, but by Tuesday it had not been claimed. Louis has a history of living on the streets and has ties to Edmonton where he spent years on the streets. He also has various medical issues. He is believed to be in Winnipeg of his own volition. Louis' whereabouts remain unknown.

Case reference: 2014004061.CaseDesc: On March 10, 1984, Robert Dwyer was seen for the last time when he left his residence at the Keirstead Trailer Park, which is located on the west side of Saint John, New Brunswick.

Jacket: Grey, Bomber, dark grey corduroy front

Case reference: 2021047301.CaseDesc: On January 1, 2001, Margarito Perez-Hernandez was seen for the last time in Toronto, Ontario.

Case reference: 2016066678.CaseDesc: On July 29, 1966, the remains of a male were recovered from the Maid of the Mist Landing, in Niagara Falls. His post-mortem weight was recorded as being 175-180 lbs and his length was measured at 5'11", however, these measurements may not represent his actual living weight and height due to post-mortem changes noted at autopsy.

Hair: Black, Short, Shorter than collar length, greying

Case reference: 2012020085.CaseDesc: Benjamin Entz was born, raised and lived on the Waldeck Hutterite Colony near Waldeck, Saskatchewan up until the time of his disappearance. His friends and family describe him as a very withdrawn individual. He left the colony the evening of September 18, 2011 on a tractor that was recovered the following day. The investigation/search for Benjamin has included numerous witness interviews, air and ground searches, and media releases, however he has yet to be located.

Case reference: 2016068414.CaseDesc: On August 30, 1965, this unidentified male was found on the shore of Lake Ontario just east of the harbour pier in Oshawa. His post-mortem weight was recorded as being 160 lbs, however, this may not represent his actual living weight due to post-mortem changes noted at autopsy. His appendix was present and he was not circumcised.

Teeth: Decayed teeth; gold inlay and prosthesis in his upper dentition; lower dentition had an amalgam filling
Shoes: Leather, Veritough, one left shoe; size 7
Scar: Right Upper Arm, circular puckered scar 1" in diameter on the anterior right underarm

Case reference: 2014005378.CaseDesc: On September 8, 2004, Robert Harrington was last seen near the intersection of Oakwood Avenue and Vaughan Road in Toronto, Ontario.

Case reference: 2014001943.CaseDesc: Kam Lee was last seen in the Bishop Grandin Highway and River Road area of Winnipeg, Manitoba. Kam's current whereabouts are unknown.

Case reference: 2016069642.CaseDesc: On April 21, 1995, the remains of a woman were discovered near Carbon, Alberta. The post-mortem interval is estimated to be between 10 and 15 years. The individual had dental restorations including stainless steel crowns.

Case reference: 2006004699.CaseDesc: On July 13 1992, William Aman left the shore of Lake Ontario to go fishing.  His boat was later found with his ball cap 3.2 kilometers off of Pete's Point, Lake Ontario. William has not been located and is presumed drowned.

Case reference: 2024015325.CaseDesc: Robert O’Toole was last seen on March 19,2024, in Central Hamilton, Ontario.  Family and colleagues have concerns regarding Robert’s health, noting a significant decline since their last interaction.

Scar: Left Chest, Horizontal scar above the left nipple.
Genitals, Surgical removal of the left testicle
Abdomen, Over the belly button from a feeding tube.

Case reference: 2014006338.CaseDesc: On November 1, 1988, George Burke was last seen by his wife, when he left their residence in Edmonton, Alberta, to take the bus to work. That day, George did not arrive at work, and it is unknown whether he caught the bus.

Case reference: 2014002401.CaseDesc: Winifred Jane Smith, better known as Jane, was a student at Laurentian University in Sudbury, Ontario. She was last seen on August 9, 1975, in her apartment just before she retired for the night at 2:00 a.m. The following day, she was not seen or heard from, and she was reported missing. Her personal belongings were left behind. There is evidence to suggest that Jane's disappearance may be a result of foul play.

Scar: Forehead, Small round scar between the eyebrows

Case reference: 2012020135.CaseDesc: On September 21, 1988, Melanie Temperton was reported missing from Montreal, Quebec. Melanie left her residence located in Mascouche, Quebec around 9:00 p.m. to go to Montreal where she met friends in different places. Melanie has not been seen or heard from since.

Case reference: 2014005935.CaseDesc: On December 4, 2012, Lucien Bélanger left his residence near the Saint-François River in Drummondville, Quebec. Lucien was despondent at the time of the disappearance.

Case reference: 2014004979.CaseDesc: On July 23, 2007, Gad Krespine, a resident of Montreal, was last seen at approximately 10:30 A.M., at 1755 Lierre Street in Laval, Quebec.

Case reference: 2006015499.CaseDesc: Richard Ranger was last seen on March 4, 1999, at Buster's Confectionary on Main Street in Haileybury.  Richard had been admitted to the Temiskaming Hospital for psychiatric assessment the same day he went missing and may suffer from mental illness. His whereabouts are unknown and foul play is not suspected at this time.

Case reference: 2009003999.CaseDesc: At about 1 p.m. Robert Aho of North Bay left Land O’Lakes Cottages located in Martin River and headed west bound on Highway 64 towards Field. He was carrying a packsack and duffle bag and has not been in contact with his family since.

Shirt: Blue, White, Long sleeved, Toronto Maple Leaf

Case reference: 2019041758.CaseDesc: On July 2, 2019, Brany Rodriguez was last seen in Waterloo, Ontario.  He was known to lead a transient lifestyle and had previously stayed in all three cities in the Region of Waterloo. His whereabouts are unknown.

Teeth: Other, Broken and missing upper and lower teeth, with gaps

Case reference: 2019070875.CaseDesc: On April 17, 2019, the remains of a woman were found in a crawl space of a triplex in Montreal, Québec.

Case reference: 2014004763.CaseDesc: On October 28, 2005, Leslie Thompson was seen for the last time in Montreal, Quebec. Leslie is known as a gambler and frequents bars.

Case reference: 2014002160.CaseDesc: Jackelene Bylow was last seen at her residence on November 13, 1994 after having dinner at a restaurant near Willington Ave and Hastings St. She suffers from mental illness and addicted to drugs and alcohol.

Tattoo: Chest, Duck and blue bird on right breast

Case reference: 2018015227.CaseDesc: On March 22, 2018, at approximately 1:00pm, Maria Ruiz Zein was last seen in Toronto, Ontario. Maria boarded a flight to go to Colombia, but has not returned to Canada.

Case reference: 2012002099.CaseDesc: Kelly Coleman was last seen near Mac's Convenience on Mapleview Drive in Barrie, Ontario in August 2011.  Kelly suffers from health-related issues and has not had contact with her family or friends since January 3, 2012. They are concerned for her well-being and are requesting assistance from anyone who may have had any contact with her.

Case reference: 2014003922.CaseDesc: On July 15, 1972, Anthony Zukewich and a friend took a canoe out onto Clearwater Lake, located northeast of The Pas in Manitoba. According to witnesses, both men were under the influence of alcohol and had brought alcohol with them into the canoe. They also noted that the lake was extremely rough due to high winds. The pair were seen departing at around 4:00 p.m., heading towards an area known as Long Point. A Long Point resident told the police that he had seen one person in the red canoe, which was sitting flat, indicating weight in the front. The canoe was recovered on July 17th. Despite extensive search efforts, Anthony was never located.

Case reference: 2014005271.CaseDesc: On May 23, 2009, Fanzheng Meng was seen for the last time at Britannia Park and Beach in Ottawa, Ontario. Fanzheng and another man had been aboard an inflatable raft on the Ottawa River. The two men did not return to the shore and the deflated raft was subsequently located.

Case reference: 2023013736.CaseDesc: On July 13, 2022, Magdalene Oerlemans was seen for the last time in Edmonton, Alberta. At the time of her disappearance, Magdalene was leading a high-risk lifestyle.

Case reference: 2014006199.CaseDesc: Albert Riddy went missing from his residence between April 5 and July 30, 2013. We have not been able to locate him since. The circumstances surrounding his disappearance are considered suspicious.

Case reference: 2015044121.CaseDesc: On September 1, 1972, Allen Robert Foy was seen for the last time leaving his home in the Saint-Hubert district of Longueuil, Quebec. Allen Robert said he was travelling on vacation north in the Laurentians to go fishing. He left in his vehicle, a green 1970’s Chrysler Newport which was found 4 or 5 years later, near the Dorval airport in Montreal, Quebec.

Case reference: 2014005768.CaseDesc: On March 16, 2012, Sol Han was seen for the last time in Toronto, Ontario. That day, Sol did not show up for school.

Case reference: 2013000043.CaseDesc: On September 4, 2010, Jonathan Jette and Rachael Bagnall went hiking in a mountainous region north of Pemberton, B.C. They intended to spend 2 to 3 days climbing some peaks in the area. They failed to return and were reported missing. Their vehicle was located however despite an extensive search, no other trace of them has been found.

Luggage: Light Green, Purple, Lavender, Mauve, 4 person tent
Sweater: Wool, Brown, White, zip up sweater (Hudson's Bay type)

Case reference: 2019044701.CaseDesc: On August 5, 2019, at approximately 6:00 am, Bridget Dalbe was seen for the last time in Toronto, Ontario.

Case reference: 2020007348.CaseDesc: On April 25, 1971, Liliam Alvarado was seen for the last time as she left her hotel room in Toronto, Ontario. Liliam left the hotel without her belongings.

Case reference: 2014002341.CaseDesc: On June 23, 1979, Terrence Henderson was last seen canoeing on Lac St. Anne in Ross Haven, Alberta.

Case reference: 2018046052.CaseDesc: On March 1, 1997, Eric Wong was seen for the last time in Toronto, Ontario. Eric was in Canada continuing his education and had contacted his mother in October 1997 for help with his tuition fees.

Case reference: 2015011636.CaseDesc: On June 20, 1998, a fisherman saw the body of a man floating in the St. Lawrence River in front of L'Île aux Vaches, Quebec.

Jewelry: Wood, rope around the neck with wooden cross
Socks: White, Grey, white top and grey on bottom
Tattoo: Right Shoulder, sword and a cross
Left Hand, Text "Ozzy", one letter on each finger

Case reference: 2014004877.CaseDesc: On February 9, 2006, Michelle Mercer was seen for the last time walking away from an argument with her boyfriend, in the area of 105 Street and 69 Avenue in Edmonton, Alberta.

Case reference: 2014003070.CaseDesc: On February 20, 1996, Yolande Trudeau Laberge was seen for the last time near the Larocque Bridge in Salaberry-de-Valleyfield, Quebec. Yolande has not been seen or heard from since.

Scar: Right Arm, Under arm, approximately 1 inch

Case reference: 2005001499.CaseDesc: Lois was last seen shortly before midnight at the Village of Lucknow reunion dance on July 3, 1988. She left there and returned to her residence in Kincardine, Ontario where she resided alone. The police investigation indicates Lois was going through her usual evening routine before retiring. Lois, described as a devoted family person and a dedicated worker, failed to report for work on July 4, 1988. Her friends and family became concerned and notified police that she was missing.

Case reference: 2014001301.CaseDesc: Harold Donald Maskell was reported missing by his cousin Mike Viger on September 11, 1999, from Coles Island, New Brunswick. Harold’s cousin Mike had come to visit him at his residence but there was no sign of him at the house. A search of the shoreline of the Canaan River returned negative results. Harold does not drive and cannot walk very far.

Case reference: 2014004043.CaseDesc: On March 8, 2002, Eva Nakanjako, her husband Robert Mukwaya, and their son Emmanuel Mukwaya were last seen in Toronto, Ontario. Eva and Robert had not shown up for work for three weeks and had not paid their rent. During the time of their disappearance, their apartment was found partially emptied.

Case reference: 2014001743.CaseDesc: On August 4, 1995, Knut Thielemann was last seen walking near the Athabasca Falls in Jasper National Park in Alberta.

Case reference: 2014004535.CaseDesc: Jack Fraser was last seen on August 2, 2004 at his place of work in downtown Vancouver. His parents reported him missing as they had not seen or heard from him in over two weeks. He has not been seen since.

Tattoo: Left Arm, Interlocking shamrock and maple leaf

Case reference: 2014005436.CaseDesc: On May 5, 2009, Mohamed Ibrahim was seen for the last time in Toronto, Ontario.

Case reference: 2018040276.CaseDesc: On November 2, 1992, at approximately 12:00pm, Luom Truong was last seen leaving his residence in Toronto, Ontario. Prior to leaving his home, Luom and his mother had an argument.

Case reference: 2006007299.CaseDesc: On November 1, 1985, Byron Simmons and Julie Ann Schneider were observed fishing from a boat in Lake Huron. They were near the Nuclear Power Generation Station, near Inverhuron, Ontario, in the outflow from the nuclear plant. The couple failed to return to their cottage and are presumed drowned.  Their boat was recovered the following spring washed up on shore to the north, near Oliphant, Ontario.

Hair: Grey, White, Other, Short, Afro style

Case reference: 2014034912.CaseDesc: Norman Playter was last seen on May 4, 2014 in the hamlet of Grasswoods Park, south of Saskatoon, Saskatchewan.  An investigation was conducted into his disappearance, which resulted in one person being charged. Although the investigation revealed who was responsible for his death, Norman's remains have not been located.

Case reference: 2014001755.CaseDesc: On July 19, 1982, at approximately 8:00 a.m., Howard Dobie was seen for the last time as he left his residence in Montreal, Quebec. Howard had left without saying where he was going. At the time of his disappearance, Howard was despondent and suffering from mental health issues.

Case reference: 2014004918.CaseDesc: On  September 15, 1993, three men were travelling up the Burntwood River in Manitoba to Wuskwatim Lake for commercial fishing. The men left Nelson House and, according to the sole survivor, they hit a rock and the engine stalled. The vessel was not equipped with a starter and the men were unable to restart the motor before passing through the rapids.   Despite an intensive search by land, sea and air, the bodies of William and Thomas were never recovered.

Case reference: 2014004211.CaseDesc: On August 24, 1987, Louis Haineault, 48 years old, was last seen heading out in a boat to fish on Cree Lake, north of Buffalo Narrows, SK. Searchers located his boat and fishing nets, however the boat was inoperable. Searches of the area failed to locate Louis.

Case reference: 2006019699.CaseDesc: Pierre Couture was last seen in Cowansville, Quebec on May 23, 2005. He may have been hiding from authorities and has not been seen since that time.

Tattoo: Right Arm, Rose with text "Sabrina" and "Amanda"

Case reference: 2014001848.CaseDesc: Laurie Baier was seen for the last time on April 27, 1977. Her vehicle was subsequently found abandoned on a forest road in Matagami, Quebec.

Case reference: 2014002164.CaseDesc: Michael Strang was last seen November 21, 1990 in Saint John, New Brunswick. Michael was a patient at Centracare psychiatric hospital where he reportedly left from a 3rd story window. Michael has not been heard or seen from since.

Tattoo: Winged heart - not sure which arm

Case reference: 2021055828.CaseDesc: Penny Yaroshuk was last seen leaving her residence in Edmonton, Alberta, on the morning of December 1st, 2021. Penny's vehicle was located abandoned in Hermitage Park, Edmonton, at 12:50 p.m. that same day. Family and friends have not heard from her since.

Case reference: 2014019687.CaseDesc: On November 23, 2013, an unidentified partial male skull was found in a forested area along a power line in Anmore near Coquitlam, BC. The decedent has likely been missing for several years.

Deformity: Head, Fractured facial bones. Underwent surgery to his skull, possibly during the 1980s or 1990s

Case reference: 2026007919.CaseDesc: Thomas “Joe” MacGillivary was last seen by a family member in Bible Hill, Nova Scotia on January 16, 2026.

Case reference: 2020011959.CaseDesc: On May 4, 1986, James Masten, Patricia Heys, Mark Smith, and Kimberly Masten were seen for the last time as they left Bluffer’s Park in Toronto, Ontario, on a 16-foot boat. The four were heading out onto Lake Ontario.

Scar: Right Eye, 2 inch scar over right eye

Case reference: 2022049190.CaseDesc: On September 28th, 2022, Joey Flett was seen for the last time after leaving a property in Gift Lake, Alberta. The vehicle Joey was reported to be driving was located at a rural location.

Case reference: 2014006178.CaseDesc: An investigation revealed that nobody had seen or heard from Alex Klym since the mid 1970's. The family had made attempts to locate Alex, but they were unsuccessful and nobody ever reported that he was missing. Inquiries were made with various government agencies in an attempt to find some evidence of him after the mid 1970's. There is no trace of him. The body of Alex has never been recovered. It is not known what happened to Alex, but foul play cannot be ruled out.

Case reference: 2025051011.CaseDesc: On September 15, 2025, Millicent Powell was reported missing to the Winnipeg Police Service. Her last known sighting was on July 18, 2025 in a rural area near Anola, Manitoba, to the east of Winnipeg.  She had confirmed that her current objective was to reach Toronto, Ontario.  Millicent adopted a transient lifestyle, is known for using housing resources for the homeless and suffers from schizophrenia and a brain trauma.

Case reference: 2008021099.CaseDesc: On September 17, 1966, Diane Prevost was seen for the last time as she was camping at Grundy Provincial Park in Britt, Ontario. During the time of her disappearance, Diane had been playing on the beach, and had told her father that she wanted to go back to the campsite. When her father turned to do so, she was gone.

Shirt: Blue, Red, checked top with red at cuffs and collar

Case reference: 2018060326.CaseDesc: On June 10, 2018, sisters Bérénice and Bérengère Paré were last seen at the Ottawa International Airport in Ottawa, Ontario. Bérénice and Bérengère, along with their mother, boarded a flight destined for Russia to visit with family. To date, the siblings have not been returned to Canada.

Case reference: 2012020005.CaseDesc: David Cox was last seen on April 8, 2011 in the Cranbrook, BC area.  He was known to be living a high risk lifestyle. His disappearance is considered suspicious in nature and foul play has not been ruled out.

Case reference: 2012020029.CaseDesc: Julie Derouin was reported missing to Lethbridge Police in June of 1983. There have been no confirmed sightings of Julie since January 1, 1980. Police investigations continue.

Case reference: 2013000140.CaseDesc: On June 1, 1981, Rene Laflamme was last seen in Montreal, Quebec. René had visited his mother in Ottawa, Ontario and had left her residence to travel back to Montreal.

Hair: Black, Straight, recently permed black hair

Case reference: 2014002240.CaseDesc: On October 17, 1993, Marcus Laing was reported missing when he failed to show up for work which was out of character for him.

Case reference: 2022006217.CaseDesc: On February 14, 2022, Jessie Morrissey's mother reported him missing from Amherst, Nova Scotia.  Jessie was last seen travelling in a dark-coloured Jeep Patriot in the Springhill area on the morning of February 13. The Jeep Patriot he was travelling in was located on snowmobile Trail 104 in Leamington, Nova Scotia later that evening.

Case reference: 2019075539.CaseDesc: On November 25, 2019, Daniel REOCH was last seen in Squamish, British Columbia.  Daniel has not been seen or heard from since.

Case reference: 2014001102.CaseDesc: On March 4, 1973, the remains of a young adult man were recovered from the Burrard Inlet in Vancouver, British Columbia. He carried a Canada flag pocket knife and is believed to have been in the water for several months prior to the discovery.

Case reference: 2017065923.CaseDesc: Oleg Chmelev was last seen at his home in the area of Morning Star Drive and Brandon Gate Drive, Mississauga, on October 30, 2017. His green bicycle was also missing and was his main mode of transportation.

Case reference: 2014001366.CaseDesc: On April 19, 1995, Paul-Henri Hardy was seen for the last time in the St-Romuald sector of Lévis, Quebec. Paul-Henry was 28 years old at the time of his disappearance.

Case reference: 2017043661.CaseDesc: In February of 2017, Robert Kovacs was seen for the last time in Toronto, Ontario. He was taken from Canada to Romania by his mother, Kinga Costiniuc.

Case reference: 2020006482.CaseDesc: On January 11, 1990, Emabit Yafru travelled from Ethiopia to Toronto, Ontario. On January 25, 1990, her husband came to Toronto and could not locate her. During the time of her disappearance, Emabit was five months pregnant.
